theme: Light theme primary for POS and Admin dashboards to ensure maximum clarity in various lighting conditions (e.g., storefronts). Support Dark theme via a toggle for Super Admin and Marketing pages to present a modern SaaS vibe.

typography.strategy: Soft Utility (Friendly yet precise for financial tools)

headings.style: tracking-tight, warm modern humanist sans. DO NOT USE Inter, Roboto, or generic sans for headings.

body.style: Clean sans, highly legible with tabular data alignment. leading-relaxed for reading blocks.

typography.utility: Overlines/Labels MUST be Uppercase + Tiny + Wide Spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).

primary.description: Vibrant Emerald Green (Indonesian Fintech standard, denotes trust, success, and digital payments).

secondary.description: Deep Navy/Slate for high-contrast typography and structural components.

rules: Never use pure black (#000000) or gray. Always tint neutral greys with blue (cool) or orange (warm).
Ensure text meets APCA standards. DO NOT use complete transparent backgrounds for overlays.

spacing_and_layouts.philosophy: Generous Spacing (2-3x typical). Containers with borders MUST have internal padding (p-6 or p-8) to prevent text collision.
spacing_and_layouts.pos_layout: High Density Layout. Strict grid hierarchy. Products catalog on left (grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4), Cart/QRIS active session on right panel (col-span-1). Use h-full to stretch children.
spacing_and_layouts.dashboard_layout: Dense Bento Grid for analytics (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4). Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6).
spacing_and_layouts.marketing_layout: The 'Tetris' Grid. Asymmetrical, wide gaps (gap-8 to gap-12). Never fill 100% of the grid perfectly. Leave breathing room.

surfaces: Glassmorphism (The 'Crystal' Variant) for Sticky Headers/Floating Navs. High opacity bg-white/70 (Light) or bg-black/60 (Dark), backdrop-blur-xl, 1px delicate inner stroke.
Neumorphism (The 'Tactile' Variant) for small toggles and quick action POS buttons.
Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look) for Data-heavy Financial Reports.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Layered shadows (ambient + direct). Use crisp edges via semi-transparent borders + soft shadows.

components.strategy: Marketing = Pure HTML + Tailwind CSS (Bento). Apps/Dashboards = Shadcn UI heavily customized.
banned_practices: Do NOT use generic Shadcn Card without customizing radius/spacing.
Do NOT use raw HTML inputs/selects, use Shadcn Form, Input, Select.

specific_components.calendar: Shadcn Calendar for report date ranges.
specific_components.dropdown: Shadcn Dropdown Menu for POS actions.
specific_components.toast: Use `sonner` for Toast notifications, especially critical for QRIS incoming money sound notifications.

rules: Hover states MUST exist on all interactive elements. Explicitly set text color on hover (e.g. hover:bg-slate-900 hover:text-white).
DO NOT use `transition: all`. Target specific properties (e.g., `transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease`).

accessibility.contrast: Normal text min 4.5:1. Large text 3:1. Interactive 3:1 against adjacent.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (kebab-case, role-based).
accessibility.focus: Focus states must have HIGHER contrast than default state.

media.rules: Images MUST NOT exceed 80vh on mobile. Use max-h-[80vh] md:max-h-none.

image_urls.description: Vibrant market stall offering local goods, fitting the UMKM theme.
Two individuals engaged in a contactless payment using a QR code scanner at a retail counter.
Hands using mobile for contactless payment at a terminal.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install Google Fonts 'Manrope' and 'IBM Plex Sans' in the project.
Install 'lucide-react' for UI icons and '@phosphor-icons/react' for complex dashboard metrics.
Implement the landing page, super admin dashboard, UMKM dashboard, and POS interface in the same app utilizing React Router or similar.
In the POS UI, implement a mock sound alert feature (using HTML5 Audio API) triggered upon a successful mock QRIS payment.
DO NOT use App.css default centered styling. Remove `text-align: center` from `.App`.
Construct the marketing Bento grids with raw HTML/Tailwind to allow asymmetry. Use Shadcn for interactive logic inside.
Always apply optical alignment over strict geometric alignment for buttons and layouts.
Use Recharts (with Shadcn integration) for the UMKM financial summary charts (income, expenses, profit).
Include `data-testid` on all buttons, forms, and critical data displays.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid generic, 'on distribution' outputs (AI slop). Make the UI creative, distinctive, and surprisingly good.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
NEVER center align the app container. Left-align dense content for better legibility.
Use modern pill-shaped or sharp buttons with interactive hover and click animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯) for icons. Rely exclusively on lucide/phosphor icons.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
For images, ALWAYS use the provided `image_urls`. Missing categories = you must use the provided URLs. DO NOT use placeholder text or placeholder services.
